brand_notes: Klipsch rates sensitivity 'in-room, half-space' (RP-500M II claims 92 dB, EAC measures about 85 dB anechoic; mfr-klipsch-rp-500m-ii, eac-klipsch-rp-500m-ii). Specs say '8 ohms compatible' not a nominal; RP-500M II measures 3.3 ohm min. Current klipsch.com bookshelf category (2026-10-11): R-40M, R-50M, RP-500M II, RP-600M II; legacy R-41M, R-51M, RP-400M, RP-500M (gen 1) pages carry 'latest' banners/refurb only and are treated as discontinued. Horn-loaded 90x90 Tractrix design, narrow-ish dispersion.
takeaways: Klippel (EAC): LW ±1.9 dB, f3 66 Hz, sensitivity 84.8 dB vs 92 dB claimed
Min impedance 3.3 Ω, min EPDR 1.8 Ω: effectively-4ohm flag despite '8 Ω compatible' rating
THD about 1.1% at 86 dB and 4% at 96 dB near 120 Hz (graph-read); no compression at 96 dB
Lifted 10-15 kHz peak; Erin recommends toe-out about 30°
No pro critic reviews and no verifiable user reports found
conflicts: Sensitivity 92 dB claimed vs 84.8 dB measured
Rated 8 Ω compatible vs 3.3 Ω measured minimum
EAC graph filenames label 'RP-500M I' on the II page
